# Bytech

> Bytech is the consultancy of Benny Truong, a technology consultant based in Stockholm, Sweden. Bytech takes on consulting assignments in technical leadership, software development, system architecture and IT infrastructure.

Bytech (bytech.se) is the company website and portfolio of Benny Truong. In Swedish: Bytech är Benny Truongs konsultbolag i Stockholm – teknikkonsult inom tekniskt ledarskap, mjukvaruutveckling, systemarkitektur, IT-infrastruktur, DevOps och R&D.

## About Benny Truong

- M.Sc. engineer (civilingenjör) from KTH Royal Institute of Technology in Stockholm.
- More than 13 years of experience in software development and IT infrastructure.
- Combines hands-on work – writing code and setting up servers – with system architecture and with building and leading technically heavy teams of senior and junior developers.
- Has worked as senior systems architect, R&D manager for data and IT infrastructure, consulting manager, technical lead, and software developer and architect.
- Many years of experience leading agile, cross-functional teams, driving architecture decisions, improving development processes and turning business needs into scalable technical solutions.

## Areas of expertise

- Tech Lead / Engineering Management: leading agile, cross-functional teams; product ownership; Scrum and SAFe; tying vision, roadmap and backlog into deliveries.
- Software Development: system architecture, requirements and code; Python and C; real-time and embedded software for electrified vehicles; full-stack web.
- IT Infrastructure: cloud platforms and developer environments built as code; Kubernetes and Azure; Infrastructure as Code; CI/CD; DevOps; IT security in line with NIS2 and CRA; monitoring, logging, backup and operations of IT services and servers.
- Data & AI: shared data and analytics platforms with clear ownership and governance.

## Clients and partners

Toptracer, Topgolf, Mycronic, X Shore, Kvadrat, Alten, Scania, Traton, Assa Abloy, Volvo.
